name: Stand for Screen with European Figures (obverse) and Landscape (reverse)
dimensions: without base: 65.8 x 32.4 cm (25 7/8 x 12 3/4 in.)
summary: This is a cast-iron stand for a two-sided table screen. One side of the screen is an enamel-painted copper plaque with European figures. The reverse side is a glass painting of architectural landscape in the Chinese style.
